title: Product price tiers
statementMd:
Classify products: `cheap` under 20, `standard` from 20 to under 100, `premium` from 100. Show name and tier.

Expected columns: `name`, `tier`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, CASE WHEN price < 20 THEN 'cheap' WHEN price < 100 THEN 'standard' ELSE 'premium' END AS tier FROM products;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
